maintenance_led.reason: Mostly sells new heat tracing, heaters and boilers for capital projects; maintenance and retrofit is a smaller share.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private oil and gas, chemical, power and industrial firms buying heat tracing and heaters.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through engineered heating products; only occasional acquisitions, such as boilers and data-center thermal deals.

mission_critical.reason: Engineered heat tracing and freeze protection are specified into plants; hazardous-location certification and process safety make switching costly.
